Careers at Edit Simple

Join Our Team

At Edit Simple, we believe in empowering creativity and innovation. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals passionate about video editing, content creation, and digital storytelling. Join our team and help us deliver cutting-edge video production and YouTube automation services to top clients across the USA and EU.

We offer a dynamic work environment, competitive benefits, and the opportunity to work on exciting projects that shape the future of digital content. Whether you are a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you have the drive to excel, we would love to hear from you.

Open Positions

Video Editor

We're looking for a talented Video Editor to create engaging, high-quality reels for Instagram and YouTube Shorts. The ideal candidate should have a strong sense of pacing, visual storytelling, and attention to detail, with the ability to turn scripts or raw footage into scroll-stopping short-form content that aligns with current trends and brand tone.

Apply Now →

Why Join Us?

At Edit Simple, you'll work with a creative and collaborative team dedicated to excellence. We value innovation, continuous learning, and fostering a supportive work culture. Take your career to the next level by joining a team that is redefining the landscape of social media management and video editing.

We would love to work with people across the globe but due to government regulations, we are currently only open to Indian citizens.
